description: Optional additions / corrections to the units built into the RP2040 firmware (length, volume, area, temperature, pressure, solar_radiation, force, flow_rate, level, mass, time, speed, energy, power, frequency, angle). Only list units that are missing or need another factor. base = value * factor + offset; base units: m, m3, m2, C, Pa, W/m2, N, m3/s, %, kg, s, m/s, J, W, Hz, rad. A new quantity needs si_base.
